name: Forest — Quiet
_doc: Non-water option in the noise-cover library. Calm forest ambience: high-frequency wind suggesting leaves + a low brown-noise pad suggesting distant rumble. No water sounds — for users who find moving water distracting or wakeful.
_pairs_with: Tonal residual or weak-tonal traffic noise. Recommender picks this when the user has set a 'no water' preference and the canceller is in TONAL or WEAK gate-open state.

layers.name: wind_canopy
layers._doc: 300-3000 Hz filtered wind, suggesting air moving through high tree canopy. The primary masker for office-chatter, traffic-tonal-residue, and most mid-band noise.

layers.name: rumble_floor
layers._doc: Brown noise 30-400 Hz. Low, sustained — like distant traffic, ventilation, or wind hitting building structure. Fills the sub-300-Hz band that wind_soft leaves bare.

states.name: breeze
states._doc: Slightly more wind, slightly less rumble — suggests a gust without becoming a storm.

description: Gentle stereo woodland: soft wind through the canopy and rustling leaves.
